result.instructions: Tools for Rosterfy, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which shifts on my next event still have no one assigned?"; "List the people who hold the first-aid certificate."; "How many reward points does this volunteer have?". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Rosterfy data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run rosterfy_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run rosterfy_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run rosterfy_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. rosterfy_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: rosterfy_get_current_user
tools.title: Get the current user
tools.description: Return the signed-in integration user: their profile, what they may do, and their user type. A quick check that the connection works. Rosterfy: GET /api/v2/user/me.

tools.name: rosterfy_list_users
tools.title: List users
tools.description: List the people on the account, one page at a time, with their contact details and custom attributes. Use filter to find someone, for example attr name with operator like. Rosterfy: GET /api/v2/user.

sort_by.description: Attribute to sort on, for example id. Sorting is not applied unless set.

filter.description: Filter conditions. Each item is {attr, operator, value}. The filterable attributes differ per resource.

tools.name: rosterfy_get_user
tools.title: Get a user
tools.description: Return one person's full record, with their subscription and verification state. Rosterfy: GET /api/v2/user/{id}.

tools.name: rosterfy_list_events
tools.title: List events
tools.description: List the events on the account, one page at a time. An event holds shifts; each shift has statuses that rosterfy_assign_user_to_shift needs. Rosterfy: GET /api/v2/event.

sort_by.description: Attribute to sort on, for example id. Sorting is not applied unless set.

filter.description: Filter conditions. Each item is {attr, operator, value}. The filterable attributes differ per resource.

tools.name: rosterfy_get_event
tools.title: Get an event
tools.description: Return one event: when and where it runs, who may see it, and the shift status defaults each shift inherits. Rosterfy: GET /api/v2/event/{id}.

tools.name: rosterfy_list_shift_assignments
tools.title: List shift assignments
tools.description: List the people on one shift, with their status and check-in times, one page at a time. Rosterfy: GET /api/v2/event/{event_id}/shift/{shift_id}/user.

sort_by.description: Attribute to sort on, for example id. Sorting is not applied unless set.

filter.description: Filter conditions. Each item is {attr, operator, value}. The filterable attributes differ per resource.

tools.name: rosterfy_get_shift_assignment
tools.title: Get a shift assignment
tools.description: Return one person's place on one shift: their status, check-in and check-out times, break and any rating. Rosterfy: GET /api/v2/event/{event_id}/shift/{shift_id}/user/{id}.

tools.name: rosterfy_list_training_modules
tools.title: List training modules
tools.description: List the training modules the account can use, including modules from an account above it. Rosterfy: GET /api/v2/training.

sort_by.description: Attribute to sort on, for example id. Sorting is not applied unless set.

filter.description: Filter conditions. Each item is {attr, operator, value}. The filterable attributes differ per resource.

tools.name: rosterfy_list_training_assignments
tools.title: List training assignments
tools.description: List the people assigned to one training module, with each person's status and progress. Rosterfy: GET /api/v2/training/{training_id}/user.

sort_by.description: Attribute to sort on, for example id. Sorting is not applied unless set.

filter.description: Filter conditions. Each item is {attr, operator, value}. The filterable attributes differ per resource.

tools.name: rosterfy_list_certificate_holders
tools.title: List certificate holders
tools.description: List the people a certificate was issued to, one row per issue. Give certificate_id for one certificate, or leave it out for all. Rosterfy: GET /api/v2/certificate/user or GET /api/v2/certificate/{certificate_id}/user.

sort_by.description: Attribute to sort on, for example id. Sorting is not applied unless set.

filter.description: Filter conditions. Each item is {attr, operator, value}. The filterable attributes differ per resource.

tools.name: rosterfy_get_reward_balance
tools.title: Get a reward point balance
tools.description: Return one user's reward point balance: the points they hold now and who they belong to. Rosterfy: GET /api/v2/reward-point/user/{id}.

tools.name: rosterfy_list_reports
tools.title: List reports
tools.description: List the account's reports and their generation state, one page at a time. This does not regenerate any report. Rosterfy: GET /api/v2/report.

sort_by.description: Attribute to sort on, for example id. Sorting is not applied unless set.

filter.description: Filter conditions. Each item is {attr, operator, value}. The filterable attributes differ per resource.

tools.name: rosterfy_get_report
tools.title: Get a report
tools.description: Return one report's definition and its generation state (queued, processing, completed or failed). This does not regenerate it. Rosterfy: GET /api/v2/report/{id}.

tools.name: rosterfy_assign_user_to_shift
tools.title: Assign a user to a shift
tools.description: Put one person on one shift at the status you give. Read the status id from rosterfy_get_event first. A status the account treats as cancelled, or a full shift, is refused with a 422. Rosterfy: POST /api/v2/event/{event_id}/shift/{shift_id}/user.

user_id.description: The user to put on the shift id.

is_leader.description: Whether this person leads the shift.

annotations.title: Assign a user to a shift

tools.name: rosterfy_remove_user_from_shift
tools.title: Remove a user from a shift
tools.description: Take one person off one shift. The assignment is soft-deleted, so the history stays. On a linked series, the first call returns a 400 that asks about later shifts; repeat the call with repeat set to true to remove them from those too. Rosterfy: DELETE /api/v2/event/{event_id}/shift/{shift_id}/user/{id}.

repeat.description: Also remove the person from every later linked shift.

annotations.title: Remove a user from a shift
